facts.fact: Africanian reports that the transport and AI ministry has funded a pilot in which UNGE and INSTTIC students build and operate the country's first AI-integrated meteorological station, training starting 21 July 2025 for five months, with a nationwide network the stated goal.

systems.owner: Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and AI Systems
